sections.title: 十seed主分析、制度设计与批次补充稳健性

figures.caption: 图1：W12–W22玩梗作者周供给；旧3、新7与合计10的方向相同，阴影为实际seed极差而非置信区间。
figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Weekly meme-author supply in W12–W22; old3, new7 and all10 retain the same direction, with shading showing the observed seed range rather than a confidence interval.

figures.caption: 图2：W19–W22五项原指标按运行批次补充分层；兴趣和时序高于随机，合计10包含旧3与新7而非独立队列。
figures.caption_en: Figure 2: The five original W19–W22 metrics supplementarily stratified by execution batch; interest and chronological exceed random, and all10 combines old3 and new7 rather than forming an independent cohort.

figures.caption: 图3：同seed配对差值显示兴趣、时序均高于随机；时序相对兴趣的供给份额在seed5反向，其余9个seed为正。
figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Within-seed contrasts place interest and chronological above random; chronological minus interest in supply share reverses for seed5 and is positive for the other nine seeds.
